patterns.title: Two Pointers
patterns.blurb: Use two indices moving through data to solve array/string problems in O(n) time and O(1) space.

patterns.title: Sliding Window
patterns.blurb: Maintain a moving window over a sequence to answer subarray/substring questions efficiently.

patterns.title: Intervals
patterns.blurb: Sort intervals by start (or end), then sweep once to merge, detect overlaps, or find gaps.

patterns.title: Stack
patterns.blurb: Use LIFO order for matching/nesting and 'process most recent first' — including monotonic stacks.

patterns.title: Linked List
patterns.blurb: Pointer manipulation — dummy heads, fast/slow pointers, reversing and rewiring nodes.

patterns.title: Binary Search
patterns.blurb: Halve a sorted or monotonic search space each step — including binary search on the answer.

patterns.title: Heap
patterns.blurb: A priority queue for top-K, streaming medians, and merging — O(log n) push/pop.

patterns.title: Depth-First Search
patterns.blurb: Recurse deep through trees, graphs, and grids — return values up or pass state down.

modules.title: Data Structures & Algorithms: Introduction
modules.summary: A visual guide to the most important algorithm patterns for coding interviews.

modules.title: Two Pointers: Overview
modules.summary: Use two pointers starting at opposite ends of a sorted array to find pairs that meet criteria in O(n) time.

modules.title: Container With Most Water
modules.summary: Pick two vertical lines from an array to form a container. Return the maximum water area (width × shorter wall).

modules.title: Two Sum (Sorted Array)
modules.summary: Find if a pair of numbers in a sorted array sums to a target using two pointers to eliminate unnecessary pairs.

modules.title: 3-Sum
modules.summary: Find all unique triplets in an array that sum to zero using sorting and two pointers.

modules.title: Valid Triangle Number
modules.summary: Count triplets in an array that can form valid triangle sides using the triangle inequality after sorting.

modules.title: Move Zeroes
modules.summary: Rearrange array by moving all zeros to end while preserving non-zero element order in-place.

modules.title: Sort Colors
modules.summary: Sort array of 0s, 1s, and 2s in-place using three-pointer Dutch National Flag partition in one pass.

modules.title: Trapping Rain Water
modules.summary: Calculate total rainwater trapped between bars using two pointers and running max heights from each end.

modules.title: Fixed-Length Sliding Window
modules.summary: Slide a window of fixed size k through an array, updating state incrementally in O(1) per element.

modules.title: Maximum Sum of Subarrays of Size K
modules.summary: Find the maximum sum among all contiguous subarrays of size k using a fixed-size sliding window with incremental sum updates.

modules.title: Max Points You Can Obtain From Cards
modules.summary: Maximize score by picking k cards from array ends by finding minimum sum window of size n-k in middle

modules.title: Max Sum of Distinct Subarrays of Length K
modules.summary: Find the maximum sum of a subarray of length k where all elements are distinct, or return 0 if no such subarray exists.

modules.title: Variable-Length Sliding Window
modules.summary: Expand and contract a window to find the longest/shortest subarray satisfying a condition in O(n) time.

modules.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
modules.summary: Find the length of the longest substring with all distinct characters using a variable-length sliding window.

modules.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
modules.summary: Find the longest substring of identical letters after replacing at most k characters in a string of uppercase English letters.

modules.title: Intervals: Overview
modules.summary: Sort intervals by start/end time, then sweep to detect overlaps and merge. Core pattern for meeting scheduling and conflict detection.

modules.title: Can Attend Meetings
modules.summary: Check if a person can attend all meetings without conflicts by detecting overlapping intervals.

modules.title: Insert Interval
modules.summary: Insert a new interval into a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals, merging any overlaps including touching intervals.

modules.title: Non-Overlapping Intervals
modules.summary: Find the minimum number of intervals to remove so remaining intervals don't overlap using greedy end-time sorting.

modules.title: Merge Intervals
modules.summary: Consolidate overlapping intervals by sorting by start time, then merging intervals that share any common time into single ranges.

modules.title: Employee Free Time
modules.summary: Find common free-time intervals across all employees by merging busy intervals and identifying gaps.

modules.title: Stack: Overview
modules.summary: LIFO data structure for managing nested sequences, undo operations, and processing most recent items first.

modules.title: Valid Parentheses
modules.summary: Check if brackets are properly nested using a stack to match opening and closing pairs in correct LIFO order.

modules.title: Decode String
modules.summary: Decode an encoded string where k[encoded_string] means repeat the string k times. Brackets can be nested.

modules.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
modules.summary: Find the length of the longest well-formed parentheses substring using a stack to track unmatched indices.

modules.title: Monotonic Stack
modules.summary: A stack variant that maintains elements in sorted order to efficiently find next greater/smaller elements in O(n) time.

modules.title: Daily Temperatures
modules.summary: Find the number of days to wait for a warmer temperature after each day using a monotonic decreasing stack of indices.

modules.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
modules.summary: Find the largest rectangular area in a histogram using a monotonically increasing stack to track bar indices in O(n) time.

modules.title: Linked List: Overview
modules.summary: Core linked list operations: traversal, insertion, deletion, fast/slow pointers, reversal, and the dummy node technique.

modules.title: Linked List Cycle
modules.summary: Detect if a linked list contains a cycle using Floyd's fast and slow pointer technique without modifying the list.

modules.title: Palindrome Linked List
modules.summary: Check if a singly linked list is a palindrome by finding the middle, reversing the second half, and comparing both halves in O(1) space.

modules.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
modules.summary: Remove the nth node from the end of a singly linked list in one pass using two pointers with a gap of n nodes between them.

modules.title: Reorder List
modules.summary: Reorder a linked list in-place to alternate between nodes from the start and end: 1st → last → 2nd → 2nd-to-last → 3rd → ...

modules.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
modules.summary: Swap every two adjacent nodes in a linked list by rewiring pointers using a dummy head to handle edge cases uniformly.

modules.title: Binary Search: Overview
modules.summary: Efficient O(log n) search algorithm that repeatedly halves the search space in a sorted array by comparing the target with the middle element.

modules.title: Koko Eating Bananas
modules.summary: Find the minimum eating speed to finish all banana piles within h hours using binary search on the answer space.

modules.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
modules.summary: Find target in rotated sorted array in O(log n) time. At each step, one half is sorted—check if target is in that half to discard the other.

modules.title: Split Array Largest Sum
modules.summary: Split array into k contiguous subarrays to minimize the maximum subarray sum using binary search on the answer space.

modules.title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
modules.summary: Find the kth smallest element in an n×n matrix where rows and columns are sorted using binary search on the value range with O(n) staircase counting.

modules.title: Minimum Shipping Capacity
modules.summary: Find minimum box capacity to ship all products within box limit, considering both capacity and weight constraints per box.

modules.title: Heap: Overview
modules.summary: A heap maintains the smallest (or largest) value at the root, enabling efficient top-K problems. Push/pop in O(log n) via bubble operations.

modules.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
modules.summary: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array using a min-heap of size k. Maintain k largest elements; the heap's root is the answer.

modules.title: K Closest Points to Origin
modules.summary: Find k closest points to origin using a max-heap of size k with negated distances, avoiding square root computation.

modules.title: Find K Closest Elements
modules.summary: Find k elements closest to a target value in a sorted array using a max-heap to track the k smallest distances.

modules.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
modules.summary: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list using a min-heap to efficiently track the smallest unmerged element from each list.

modules.title: Find Median from Data Stream
modules.summary: Track the running median of a data stream using two heaps: a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half, kept balanced.

modules.title: DFS: Introduction
modules.summary: Learn Depth-First Search, a traversal algorithm that explores as far down a path as possible before backtracking. Master the recursive pattern for trees and graphs.

modules.title: DFS: Fundamentals
modules.summary: Learn the fundamentals of Depth-First Search: how DFS traverses binary trees using recursion, the call stack, and backtracking.

modules.title: DFS: Return Values
modules.summary: Learn how to design what each DFS call returns to its parent (bottom-up) and combine left/right results to solve binary tree problems recursively.

modules.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
modules.summary: Find the maximum depth of a binary tree, defined as the number of nodes along the longest path from root to leaf using recursive DFS.

modules.title: Path Sum
modules.summary: Determine if a binary tree has a root-to-leaf path where values sum to a target using DFS, checking for equality only at leaf nodes.

modules.title: Passing Values Down & Helper Functions
modules.summary: Learn to pass state down via helper function parameters (top-down) vs returning up, and when to use outer variables to collect results.

modules.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
modules.summary: Validate a BST by passing min/max bounds down the tree. Each node must lie strictly within its inherited range.

modules.title: Calculate Tilt
modules.summary: Calculate the total tilt of a binary tree, where each node's tilt is the absolute difference between its left and right subtree sums.

modules.title: Diameter of a Binary Tree
modules.summary: Find the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree using DFS to track height and diameter simultaneously.

modules.title: Path Sum II
modules.summary: Find all root-to-leaf paths in a binary tree where node values sum to a target using DFS with backtracking to explore and collect valid paths.

modules.title: Longest Univalue Path
modules.summary: Find the longest path in a binary tree where all nodes have the same value. Use post-order DFS to calculate same-value arms at each node.

modules.title: Graphs: Overview
modules.summary: Introduction to graph fundamentals: vertices, edges, neighbors, cycles, and the critical importance of tracking visited nodes during DFS traversal.

modules.title: Adjacency List
modules.summary: Learn how to represent graphs using adjacency lists, build them from edge lists, and perform DFS traversal with proper visited tracking.

modules.title: Copy Graph
modules.summary: Convert a node-and-pointers graph structure into a dictionary adjacency list using depth-first search traversal with cycle detection.

modules.title: Graph Valid Tree
modules.summary: Determine if undirected edges form a valid tree by checking two conditions: no cycles exist and all nodes are connected in a single component.

modules.title: Matrices (Grid DFS)
modules.summary: Learn how to apply DFS to 2D grids by treating each cell as a node with up to 4 neighbors, using bounds checking and visited tracking.

modules.title: Flood Fill
modules.summary: Perform a flood fill on a grid by starting at a given pixel and recoloring all 4-connected pixels that share the same original color.

modules.title: Number of Islands
modules.summary: Count connected regions of land ('1') in a binary grid by scanning cells and using DFS to mark entire islands as visited.

modules.title: Surrounded Regions
modules.summary: Modify a grid to replace all 'O' regions completely surrounded by 'X' with 'X'. Use reverse logic: mark border-connected 'O's as safe via DFS.

modules.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
modules.summary: Find all cells in a grid where water can flow to both Pacific (top/left edges) and Atlantic (bottom/right edges) oceans using boundary DFS.
